name: Super Jumbo acoustic (Ample SJ)
_notes: Ample SJ: string keyswitches G0–C1 (31–36) = 6th → 1st string (checked: inharmonicity falls 6th → 4th). Keyswitches C0 sustain, C#0 harmonic, D0 palm mute, D#0 slide in, E0 legato slide, F0 hammer/pull. Mic 1/2/3 = body / neck / AB pair: the main stem is body + a little neck (folds to mono cleanly), the 'ab' stem is the spaced pair for width in stereo only. Harmonics at frets 5 and 12 (fretStep 7 from 5).
